title: Fix the three M0 defects the M1.2 cross-check found (t09, t11, t20)
acceptance: Escape candidates are attributed per task: a task is listed only when a later fix touches one of its own changed files (its base to its measured end, or to the goal head when unmeasured); a revert of the merge still lists every task; a task git cannot measure is skipped without failing the others
The report's new process call list includes C's posix_spawn and posix_spawnp alongside the existing exec/system patterns
hq trace treats a goal file's top-level acceptance list as the criteria of its single task (named after the goal) when the file has no tasks; the multi-task form is unchanged
Each behaviour has a test in hq/test that fails on main and passes on this branch; cd hq && bun test --timeout 30000 && bunx tsc --noEmit pass
